description: MainActivity for the Smart Home TV app, responsible for hosting navigation sidebar and fragment content area, managing UI navigation and focus states.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing navigation between Dashboard and Settings fragments with focus handling for TV remote navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and loads the initial Dashboard fragment.

methods.name: setupSidebar
methods.description: Configures focus behaviors and click listeners for sidebar navigation TextViews.

methods.name: showSection
methods.description: Switches active fragment to either Dashboard or Settings and updates the UI with a toast message.
